metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		VALUES('sales'[CITY])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0Core, 'sales'[CITY], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'sales'[CITY]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'sales'[CITY])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('sales'[CITY], __DS0FilterTable, "Total_Sales", 'sales'[Total Sales])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Sales], 0, 'sales'[CITY], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Sales] DESC, 'sales'[CITY]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'sales'[CITY])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('sales'[PRODUCT_CATEGORY], __DS0FilterTable, "Total_Sales", 'sales'[Total Sales])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Sales], 0, 'sales'[PRODUCT_CATEGORY], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Sales] DESC, 'sales'[PRODUCT_CATEGORY]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'sales'[CITY])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('sales'[Month Number], __DS0FilterTable, "Total_Sales", 'sales'[Total Sales])

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(3500, __DS0Core, 'sales'[Month Number], [Total_Sales], 350, , ALPHABETICAL, ASC, 105000, 60)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'sales'[Month Number]
